summary: Frontend-only verification on PREVIEW (https://noc-monitor-4.preview.emergentagent.com) of the reported bug 'Uncaught ReferenceError: showInstall is not defined at AgentsPage.js:436' on route /agents. Logged in as admin (info@86bit.it) with 2FA TOTP via Playwright, reached /agents both by direct URL and by sidebar navigation. The page renders correctly (header 'Agent v4 (Connector Go)', KPI cards, bulk-update banner, table with 8 agent rows). ZERO pageerror events and NO 'showInstall' reference in any console/page error. Also exercised refresh button, search filter and clear filter — all functional. Bug is NOT reproducible on current preview code; source grep confirms no 'showInstall' identifier anywhere in /app/frontend/src.

issues: Column 'IP PUBBLICO' renders for all rows but every agent shows '—' (no public_ip persisted yet, all 8 agents OFFLINE), therefore data-testid agent-tcp-probe-<id> is never rendered and the TCP probe control could not be exercised end-to-end. Not a code defect, just missing data.

action_items: No fix needed for /agents ReferenceError — preview bundle is clean. The production instance (argus.86bit.it) is still serving the OLD bundle: redeploy/rebuild production and instruct the user to hard-reload (new hashed bundle) to clear the stale showInstall chunk.

OPTIONAL (minor): React dev hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered inside a route under ProtectedRoute (not AgentsPage — its <option> children are plain text). Track down the offending <select><option><span> markup elsewhere.
OPTIONAL: one 403 resource response observed during the login phase only (before token issuance); no 4xx/5xx after authentication on /agents.

TCP probe path (agent-tcp-probe-<id>) is untestable in this environment since no agent has public_ip; consider seeding a public_ip value for QA.
